    [rom] zscustom_v3_required: ZSCustomOverworld v3 is required; this ROM reports ASM version 0xFF at $28:8145
    [patch] blank_stream_invalid: blank map stream at $30:8000 is 188 bytes with no $FF terminator; decoding reads past it and stops at $30:80BC after 94 decoded bytes (ran past the end of the data before $FF)
    [patch] blank_stream_invalid: blank map stream at $30:9000 is 4 bytes with no $FF terminator; decoding reads past it and stops at $30:9004 after 2 decoded bytes (ran past the end of the data before $FF)
    [patch] tail_tables_missing: the patch extends only the map32 pointers; 11 other per-area tables stop before $A0, so a tail area reads the data after each of them (parent, area_gfx, area_palette, sw_sprite_gfx, sw_entry_gfx, sw_palette_a, sw_palette_b, sign_message, music_dw_sw, hidden_items, area_flags)
    [yaze] pointer_save_desync: after the patch the game reads map pointers from $28:A400/$28:A640, but yaze's overworld save writes 0x1794D/0x17B2D, so the next save leaves maps $00-$9F stale in game

    [rom] rom_too_small: the ROM is 1048576 bytes; the patch writes up to PC 0x181004, so asar would expand it
